subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: For an accepted Gateway run whose CLI connection becomes uncertain, should `openclaw agent` first attempt bounded recovery and then retain the existing automatic isolated embedded fallback, or should an unproven outcome fail closed by default?
rationale: Either choice changes established CLI output, latency, duplicate-side-effect exposure, and `--deliver` behavior; the open canonical issue records that this is product policy rather than a mechanical repair choice.

options.title: Recover first, preserve automatic fallback
options.body: Attempt bounded wait/replay for the authoritative run, then retain the current fresh isolated fallback only when recovery cannot establish a terminal outcome.

options.title: Recover first, fail closed
options.body: After bounded recovery cannot prove the original outcome, return an explicit unknown-outcome error and require a deliberate separate rerun.

recommendation.title: Recover first, preserve automatic fallback
recommendation.body: Attempt bounded wait/replay for the authoritative run, then retain the current fresh isolated fallback only when recovery cannot establish a terminal outcome.

likelyOwner.reason: Introduced the merged current fallback behavior whose compatibility contract this PR revises.
